## What should this part do?

A clear description of the part and the problem it solves.

## What does it mount, hold, or connect?

E.g. "holds a 9g mini servo flat against a PRPOL plate, shaft pointing down".

- Component being mounted (with links to its specs if possible)

Paste links to datasheets, photos, or similar designs.
